item.title: Kapiti takes aim at freshwater 'possums' - Inside Government NZ
item.description: A Kapiti Coast catchment is well on the way to becoming koi carp-free, the Department of Conservation (DOC) has confirmed. The Department partnered with mana whenua to eradicate introduced koi carp from stormwater retention ponds on private land in Paraparaumu.
